ConnectorSiblingOverlap.item: Check sibling lane provinces/skills for ownership overlap with the bounded ANSI-C code_view change and empty-panel replay. Return only concrete overlap with a path and citation; do not recommend absorbing other-domain work.

ScoutC1DataWalk.item: Walk the committed r36 control receipts and identify exactly which self-assessment/evidence assertion contains the unreachable scratch revision. Re-run the old-hash reachability command and state the observed result.

ScoutC2DataWalk.item: Walk the code_view implementation, its selftest, and the r35 AttackQuotedHash note. Separate the named ANSI-C quote defect from the still-open nested-substitution and line-continuation cases.

ScoutBashSource.item: Re-open the pinned Bash 5.3 `doc/bashref.texi` §ANSI-C Quoting at commit b8c60bc9ca365f8261fa97900b6fa939f6ebc303. Verify the <=25-word quote and exact line/section anchor supporting only `$'...'` escape behavior.

ExecEmptyPanelReplay.item: In a separate worktree, run the committed empty-panel replay adapter against its frozen source revision and manifest revision. Record the v1/v2 labels, exit codes, tree identities, and whether any input path falls outside the lane object database.

ExecCounterRepin.item: In a separate worktree, run the r37 counter re-pin wrapper at its frozen tool/counter hashes over the committed public and sealed panel. Preserve full stdout/stderr/exit and report whether every frozen v2 predicate count matches.

ExecCodeViewSuite.item: In a separate worktree, run the code_view measurement and tally-audit-v3 selftest against the committed tool revision. Report the two targeted fixture results, complete selftest tally, tool digest, and exit codes.

ExecCalibrationCounter.item: In a separate worktree, run the r37 calibration mismatch counter at the frozen r36 base and the candidate final revision. Re-derive the counter's result from the cited scorecard, manifest, and receipts without altering its predicate.

ScribeRoundLesson.item: Draft the round-37 lesson Gate and Mistakes entries from committed evidence. Include S104 URL/date/located quote, the class/evidence/captured-by/fix fields, and retain the explicit parser non-goals. Do not write outside your report.

ReviewC1Claim.item: Adversarially review C1's one-mismatch predicate. Try to falsify that the old scratch commit is the only live discrepancy or that the new manifest and v1/v2 outputs actually resolve the input. Report command/output and verdict.

CriticC2Predicate.item: Attack the frozen C2_R37 predicate: check that the escaped-apostrophe comment fixture is discriminating and that the literal-hash control prevents overblanking. Do not broaden the claim after seeing results.

MutateAnsiBranch.item: On a disposable copy, remove only the new ANSI-C quote state branch and run the frozen two-case measurement. Verify the escaped-quote case becomes red while the literal-hash case remains the control; report exact diff and output.

MutatePanelManifest.item: On a disposable copy, alter the committed empty-panel source tree ID or specimen inventory one field at a time. Confirm the replay adapter refuses before scoring and does not silently accept a mismatched input.

MutatePanelContent.item: On a disposable copy, add one specimen JSON beside the empty-panel manifest. Confirm the replay adapter rejects the mutant tree as non-empty before invoking either counter.

ReviewToolPin.item: Verify the new tally-audit tool SHA in counter-pin.json matches committed bytes and the r36 counter source hash is unchanged. Re-run the hash commands and report any stale pin or unbounded claim.

ReviewSourceScope.item: Compare the S104 row and lesson quote to the official Bash 5.3 source. Confirm the source supports the implemented ANSI-C quote behavior but does not support claims about nested command substitutions or full Bash lexing.

CriticBoundedParser.item: Look for wording in the frozen contract, code docstring, scorecard, and report that accidentally claims a full shell lexer. Flag every sentence that exceeds the two measured ANSI-C fixtures.

RevengerR36Input.item: Reconstruct the r36 emptied-panel control's object history from the report/receipt and lane Git. Determine why the old scratch revision is unavailable and whether the r37 spec can recreate the exact zero-slot input at closure.

RevengerCounterFidelity.item: Reverse-engineer the r35/v2 counter input loading and output semantics. Verify that the r37 adapter changes only the public-panel source path and leaves runner, sealed set, tool bytes, and scoring predicate unchanged.

SimplifyReplayAdapter.item: Review the committed replay adapter for the smallest correct mechanism. Identify removable checks/abstractions only if their removal preserves source-tree pinning, empty-panel refusal, frozen counter bytes, and explicit exit evidence.

ReviewNoHarm.item: Re-derive the current owned axis measurements and SHONEN restraint from committed inputs. Report any score/status harmed by the round's source, quality, scorecard, or tool edits.

CriticClaimSeparation.item: Challenge whether C1 evidence-input calibration and C2 ANSI-C parser capability are causally separable, distinct, and measured with the same frozen predicate as the contract.

MutateAnsiLiteralHash.item: On a disposable copy, weaken the code_view scanner so `#` inside `$'literal # data'` is blanked. Confirm the literal-hash fixture catches this overblanking and records the exact failing output.

ScoutProtocolAnchor.item: Walk the current PROTOCOL evidence standard and the r36 verifier spotcheck. Return the exact rule and pointer showing why a scratch commit hash was not closure-resolvable.

ScribeQualityCriterion.item: Draft one falsifiable QUALITY criterion for committed mutation-control inputs or bounded code_view quote support, grounded in a round-37 Mistakes row and the command that can fail.

ReviewQualityCriterion.item: Review the proposed round-37 QUALITY criterion for scope, source grounding, append-only form, and an actual red-before falsifier. Reject any generic or untestable wording.

CriticMonitorDrift.item: Attack the claim that calibration remains 8 after edits to SOURCES, QUALITY, SCORECARD, and LOG. Re-run the strict cold-read monitor at the measured revision and identify drifted entries.

MutateAnsiEscapePair.item: Probe ANSI-C quote handling with one and two backslashes before a single quote. Compare bash lexical boundaries with code_view and state whether the frozen supported-form claim holds or must remain narrower.

ReviewPanelCardinality.item: Re-derive the nine source specimens from the pinned r36 source tree and verify the committed empty tree contains only its manifest. Report both tree IDs and exact counts.

CriticSHONENRestraint.item: Check SHONEN.md and the r37 report keep every box `[~]` with resolvable evidence and no unsupported `[x]`; flag any claimed independent verifier that was dispatched by tameshi.

MutateCalibrationMarker.item: On a disposable scorecard copy, remove the r37 append-only correction marker while keeping the committed replay receipts. Confirm the calibration counter restores one mismatch rather than accepting stale r36 prose.

ReviewFrontierStatus.item: Review the S104 row, search log, and source-census output for correct ID allocation, tier, status, access date, quote grounding, used-by, and any old-to-new registry field flips.

ReviewL0Questions.item: Read the current L0 queue and SHONEN checklist without editing them. Report whether round 37 needs an L0 question and whether all four boxes remain lane-asserted only.
